The Nasdaq 100 Index trimmed losses that had briefly tipped the gauge into bear-market territory and the S&P erased most of an earlier large decline, with dip buyers emerging even as doubts remained about the outlook for artificial intelligence. The Russia/Ukraine War is testing NATO’s plan for military action. Plus, Trump is targeting China, EU with new tariffs citing overcapacity. All on the latest episode of “Bloomberg Businessweek Daily.”
